name: MNDA knowledge — grounded answers v1
description: Questions a case officer or contact-centre agent asks every day. A case passes when the grounded answer contains every expected fact and cites at least one source.

cases.q: How recent must a salary certificate be for a housing grant application?
What is the household income ceiling for the housing grant, and the maximum grant amount?
What is the maximum interest-free housing loan and over how many years can it be repaid?
How long does an applicant have to provide missing documents before the application is closed?
Which districts require a master-developer NOC for building permits?
How long is a master-developer NOC valid for?
What is the service level and the fee for a new building permit?
Can an AI tool approve or reject a housing application? Who decides?
expect: Head of the Housing Applications Section
